limitations: Evidence class: software verification of a development tool (test-impact selection), not of the simulator. Status is tested: CI is green on both legs at ef915499 (run 43365514889) and the design lane has reviewed it (docs/reviews/S16-review.md, all findings addressed by B-12 to B-19); the review block stays pending until human sign-off.
Requirements empty: S16 maps to no D/A requirement; it is a development-process package (R-1040).
Selection is an inner-loop aid only (R-1040): CI on both architectures stays the merge gate, with F0 on main after the merge. A passing selection is never merge evidence.

The open-file record sees only Python-level opens in the test-map venv's interpreter and its Python children: files read only by non-Python children (git, bash, node) are invisible to it, and a file read both ways maps only to its Python readers.

Shared state the build's restore does not reach (objects held deeper than a module-level instance, rebound class attributes, state outside the repository's modules) can still attribute shared work to the first test that does it; seeded changes measure the recall, they do not prove it.

At a9e733e4, 5 of 20284 tests fail under the map build and pass without it (4 from module-scoped state the restore resets, 1 timing budget under coverage); their map is that of the failing run (docs/S16_DECISIONS.md B-6).

The recall check's per-case results are in recall-run3.json, recall-run4.json and recall-run5.json beside this manifest and in docs/S16_DECISIONS.md, Recall; the history replay (b) was not done (one map per base, about 70 min each).
The map is built on Linux x86-64 (SMM-TR09, 16 cores) with pytest-xdist; the build reads /proc for the process chain, so it is Linux-only. select and run need only the standard library.
Namespace enumeration (vars(module), dir(), inspect.getmembers) does not select tests for a new def (docs/test-impact.md, Limitations).
A session-scoped fixture that runs a changed line for tests in another file is a residual risk of whole-file widening (B-11).
A map built before B-16 and B-17 needs a rebuild to measure docs/*.py and to link getfixturevalue fixtures; until then select falls back on any docs/*.py change.
